title: Tremolo / autopan
description: Moves the level of the sound (tremolo) or its place between left and right (autopan), at a rate in Hz or locked to the tempo; with shape gate and a step pattern it is a trance gate that cuts a steady pad into rhythm.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.doc: Off passes the sound through untouched (bypass).

parameters.name: mode
parameters.doc: tremolo moves the level; autopan moves the sound between left and right (a mono input becomes stereo).

parameters.name: rate
parameters.doc: How fast it moves, in cycles per second. Ignored when sync is not off.

parameters.name: sync
parameters.doc: Locks the rate to the tempo: one cycle per note value (1/4 is one per quarter note).

parameters.name: depth
parameters.doc: How far it moves: 0 changes nothing, 100 goes to silence (tremolo) or fully to one side (autopan).

parameters.name: shape
parameters.doc: The shape of the movement. gate is a trance gate: the level follows the step pattern (see pattern) in time with the tempo, with a very short fade (2 ms) at every change so it does not click.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.doc: Only for shape gate: one character per step, x is fully open, . is closed, and the letters a to i are in-between levels (a is 10 percent open, e 50, i 90; 1 also means fully open, kept from the first version); every step is as long as the sync note value (1/16 when sync is off), and the pattern repeats. depth sets how far a closed step goes down (100 is silence). On a steady pad this gives the rhythmic trance cut.

parameters.name: phase
parameters.doc: Where in the cycle it starts.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).
